findings.checkpoint_restore: Each frozen checkpoint uses strict state load; source final equals checkpoint2400 elementwise. Cached projected features remain valid only after per-checkpoint projection and input_transform equality checks.
findings.run_resume: No output-record cache reuse or resume. Existing execution/ rejects before importing Torch; failure evidence is preserved. This is distinct from restoring historical checkpoint weights.
findings.unique_argmax: Shape49x2x6, finite logits, exactly one maximum per code/goal. Exact tie raises TieError with raw logits; no dropping problematic directions or menu fallback.
findings.menu_equivariance: Read-only AST proof checks menu appears only as final gather. Independent synthetic evaluation verifies every one of720 permutations retains physical argmax when unique.
findings.photo_indexing: Execute uses repeat(map,16) and tile(photo,30), with fixed16 validation pairs. Independent index test reproduces480 messages, heldout96 per direction, and detects a single-photo change.
findings.endpoint_anchor: Source final table49 rows plus physical720-menu digest and60 compatible codebook rows are matched. Each source row is reconstructed from raw emitted/delivered histograms and goal correctness. Individual photo-to-message correspondence is not available in old source codebooks.
findings.update0: Compares full receiver record, emitted messages and photo pairs within seed/direction across15 conditions. Delivered messages deliberately excluded for blocked. Expected112 comparisons from120 initial direction records minus8 references.
findings.aggregation: 60runs x8checkpoints x2directions=960; each emits480 messages. Splits/directions average within seed; all4 seed values retained; zero-failure conditional fractions remain undefined.
findings.freeze: Plan, all source hashes and source snapshots are checked before execution and again before completion. Synthetic source/snapshot mutations are rejected.

limitations: This is a post-hoc exploratory checkpoint probe, not a preregistered language-formation experiment.
Synthetic verification does not establish actual network outputs, absence of real ties, or successful final anchors; those require the root-run probe.
The8 saved checkpoints do not identify the exact first appearance of language or a unique causal learning mechanism.
No previous trained agent source was edited and no original-task analysis was invoked.
